posts.caption:
Your complaint. Heard. Tracked. Resolved. 🍁

ComplaintCA helps people in Canada take a problem to the right authority — free, in 7 languages, with an anonymous option.

Start at complaintca.ca

Filing a complaint shouldn't feel like a maze.

1️⃣ Tell us what happened — type or speak, in your own language
2️⃣ We match it to the right authority for your province
3️⃣ Send it and keep your reference number

complaintca.ca

The CRA will never ask you to pay with gift cards. 🚩

Got a letter, text or email that feels off? Check it on ComplaintCA before you pay or click.

Report scams to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre: 1-888-495-8501

complaintca.ca

Mould, no heat, repairs ignored? 🏚️

Every province has a tenancy board that can order your landlord to make repairs:
• Ontario — Landlord and Tenant Board
• BC — Residential Tenancy Branch
• Alberta — RTDRS
• Quebec — Tribunal administratif du logement

Find yours at complaintca.ca

Your employer didn't pay you? In Ontario you generally have 2 years to file an Employment Standards claim with the Ministry of Labour — and it's free.

Other provinces have their own deadlines. Check yours at complaintca.ca

Your bank said no? That's not the end. 🏦

✓ Banks must respond to complaints within 56 days
✓ Then you can go to OBSI — free and independent
✓ File with OBSI within 180 days of the bank's final answer

complaintca.ca

Facing discrimination at work, in housing or in services?

In Ontario, you must apply to the Human Rights Tribunal within one year of the last incident. Don't wait.

Find the right body for your province at complaintca.ca

Speak up in the language you think in. 🌐

ComplaintCA works in English, Français, 中文, Español, العربية, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ and Türkçe.

complaintca.ca

Afraid to speak up? 🔒

You can report anonymously on ComplaintCA. Some bodies can't open a formal file without your identity — we tell you when, so you can decide.

complaintca.ca

Your representatives work for you. 🏛️

Enter your postal code on ComplaintCA to find your federal and provincial representatives and contact them directly.

complaintca.ca
